events.title: Data Diplomats AI Workshop for Nonprofits (Intermediate Level)
events.summary: Over 90 minutes, we engineer four practical AI workflows for nonprofit operations, step by step, and practice prompting so you leave with something you can run at your organization.
schedule: Next hour: practice prompting and debugging your workflow

builds.title: Meeting notes to CRM
builds.detail: Save meeting summaries, action items and key decisions into your CRM.

builds.title: Grant opportunity monitor
builds.detail: Post relevant new grants, with deadlines, into your Slack channel.

builds.title: Social media drafting
builds.detail: Draft posts in your organization’s voice and queue them in Buffer for review.

builds.title: Volunteer communication agent
builds.detail: Draft shift reminders, onboarding messages and thank-yous, with human review before anything is sent.

events.audience: An intermediate workshop. It assumes you already know the basics of AI and large language models, such as what a prompt is, why models sometimes make things up, and why human review matters.
events.prerequisites: Set up and test accounts for Granola, Claude, Slack, Gmail, Google Workspace and Buffer (a free account is enough) before you come. The Luma page links to each getting-started guide.
bring: A laptop with a working microphone and camera, and a stable internet connection
A real or sample workflow from your organization that you would like to automate
Any CRM you use, or a free trial, so we can connect a test record
